notes: Fixed Auto-assign drive mapping failing with Internal Server Error because the Node API service user could not write /opt/rip-node/drive-map.json.
Bundled Rip Node API v0.2.6 stores persistent drive mappings in the node user's writable ~/.config/rip-node directory.
Existing readable /opt/rip-node/drive-map.json settings are migrated automatically when present.
Fresh-node installation now gives the node user ownership of /opt/rip-node and installs the API file with the correct owner.
After installing the Manager update, the manual Node update installs v0.2.6 without requiring Ubuntu reinstallation or deleting the node.
The v0.18.1 readiness checks, background progress and manual-only update policy are preserved.
